intro.text: Same brownie recipe in four looks, plus E: A’s calm with C’s numbers and pan diagrams (chosen). Each opens scaled from a 9 in round to a 9×13 pan. Press Play: the ½× 1× 2× 3× chips, US / Metric, Reset and More (pan picker) all work. Every amount, “orig.” label and warning is real render() output.

wfIntro.text: The four screens in E’s real look (structure approved 2026-11-25). Press Play and tap through: list → recipe → ⋯ → edit; list → New → import. Recipe amounts are real render() output; parser chips on 3 and 4 are hand-written (the parser is M5). Notes below each screen: the components it implies and where its state lives.

wf1.text:
Components: SearchField · NewRecipeMenu · RecipeCard · EmptyState
State: search text in the URL (?q=), so it survives refresh and back.
Empty state is the first-run screen: offers the three ways in (import, paste, write). Tweak “empty” to see it.

wf2.text:
Components: ScaleBar (chips + ×factor) · UnitToggle · WarningList · IngredientLine (amount, name, prep, orig.) · ScaleSheet (factor / yield / PanPicker with PanDiagram) · RecipeMenu
URL state: mode, factor, qty, pan, depth, units (lib/culinary/url.ts).
Component state: sheet and menu open.
Reset (view) and Version history (data) are deliberately in different places (doc §2).

wf3.text:
Components: RecipeMetaForm · SectionList (drag to reorder) · ParsedLineEditor (text input → chips) · ChipPicker (unit / ingredient) · AddIngredientForm · SaveBar
State: draft in component state; Save writes the normalized rows + a new version snapshot.
Decided: an unmatched ingredient can be added to “my ingredients” (ingredients row with owner_id). Weight of 1 cup is optional; given, it’s stored as g ÷ 236.588 = density g/ml. Without it the line scales but never converts to grams.

wf4.text:
Components: SourceCard · ReviewLine (raw_text + chips, confidence < 0.8 highlighted) · PasteFallback · ImportBar
State: import_jobs row (server) + edits in component state until Import.
Decided: “stick” of butter converts at parse time to 4 oz per stick (stored unit oz, raw_text keeps “1 stick”). US shows 4 oz, Metric 115 g (render() output).
